main.description: Ask the appview to index a space. Any member may ask, with the same authentication as garden.engram.searchMemories. The appview's own account must be a member of the space: adding it is how the space's authority agrees to have the space indexed. Registering a space that's already indexed succeeds and changes nothing.

space.description: The space URI, in canonical form.

errors.name: RegistrationClosed
errors.description: This appview indexes only the spaces its operator configures.

errors.name: NotAMember
errors.description: The appview's account isn't a member of the space.
